purpose: Obtain the actual canonical local-player save scope before original startup without a completion forced onto main.
implemented_source: Caller must be off main and outside every Core owner queue; a dispatch-specific owner marker rejects self/cross-owner queue entry before synchronous owner dispatch.
Preparation uses this exact existing owner queue/connection and refuses a held Creator lease. No parallel SQLite connection or saved-state folder is opened by a new helper.

Existing clocked profile.refresh executes with empty caller arguments. Only the fixed PROFILE_NOT_FOUND result permits existing clocked profile.create, also with empty caller arguments and fresh own command id.
No caller clock, player stats, starting holdings, identity text, tutorial completion, rewards or account values enter this API. Existing Core approved/master-backed policy remains authoritative.

The same owner block reads actual projection admission and the canonical own player snapshot, checking exact local-player/content identity. The immutable result returns on the preparation caller queue with profile_created metadata.
Actual scope is derived by the existing Core admission routine; the API never guesses it from paths/content metadata. Later adapters still recheck exact current scope and owner identity.
limits: The future native startup must execute the preparation phase on its dedicated IO queue before invoking the main-thread integrated factory. Calling this synchronous API from main is deliberately rejected.
No concrete integrated startup factory/phase is wired by this API. Native language/origin selection, actual master compatibility, original-client login and gameplay remain independent gates.
This is source review only. A prepared scope is not acceptance of a real client, a clean original engine projection, actual saved gameplay or a physical Duo display.
Only native memory receives the snapshot; source code does not log, upload or persist its returned player values.
